question_text: Explain why ROM is suitable for retaining the fixed startup instructions of a traffic controller when its power is off.
adaptation_rationale: ROM purposes are explicitly included. Scenario and wording rewritten; source reasoning retained only within supported 2027 scope.
solution: ROM is nonvolatile, so its stored startup instructions survive loss of power and are available at the next startup.
